items.title: مشاوره تخصصی افزایش فروش سایت
items.description:
🔴 مشاوره تخصصی افزایش فروش سایت

🔹 سلام، وقت بخیر
برای فروشگاه اینترنتی دارمارت کمپ در حوزه تجهیزات کمپینگ، کوهنوردی و طبیعت‌گردی، به دنبال یک مشاور حرفه‌ای فروش اینترنتی، بازاریابی دیجیتال و بهینه‌سازی نرخ تبدیل (CRO) هستیم.
فروشگاه فعال است و از طریق گوگل، ترب و سایر کانال‌ها بازدیدکننده و سفارش دریافت می‌کند. در ماه‌های گذشته اقداماتی برای بهبود سئو، سرعت، تجربه کاربری، فرایند خرید و رفع مشکلات فنی انجام شده است.
در حال حاضر هدف ما افزایش تعداد سفارش‌های موفق، افزایش سود خالص، بهبود نرخ تبدیل و استفاده بهینه‌تر از بودجه تبلیغاتی موجود است.
موضوعات اصلی مشاوره
افزایش نرخ تبدیل و فروش سایت
بررسی رفتار کاربران، به‌خصوص کاربران موبایل که سهم اصلی فروش را دارند؛ شناسایی دلایل خروج بدون خرید، تحلیل قیف فروش و ارائه راهکارهای عملی برای افزایش تعداد سفارش‌ها.
بهینه‌سازی فروش و تبلیغات ترب
ما ماهانه حداقل ۳۰ میلیون تومان برای ترب هزینه می‌کنیم و قصد داریم بازده این سرمایه‌گذاری را افزایش دهیم.
نیاز داریم عملکرد محصولات از نظر تعداد کلیک، هزینه جذب مشتری، نرخ تبدیل، فروش و حاشیه سود بررسی شود و مشخص شود بودجه تبلیغات بهتر است روی کدام محصولات متمرکز شود.
شناسایی و استفاده از محصولات قلاب (Hook Products)
یکی از موضوعات مهم برای ما، شناسایی محصولات ارزان‌قیمت و پرتقاضایی است که مشتریان برای مقایسه قیمت آن‌ها وارد فروشگاه می‌شوند؛ مانند لیوان سیلیکونی تاشو و سایر لوازم کمپینگ.
می‌خواهیم بدانیم چطور این محصولات را شناسایی و اولویت‌بندی کنیم و از طریق فروش مکمل، پیشنهادهای هدفمند و افزایش ارزش سبد خرید، آن‌ها را به یک فرصت سودآور تبدیل کنیم.
همچنین به راهنمایی درباره نحوه مدیریت محصولات متغیر و تنوع‌های رنگی در ترب نیاز داریم.
افزایش میانگین مبلغ سفارش و خرید مجدد
بررسی استراتژی‌های Cross-sell، Up-sell، فروش پکیجی، پیشنهاد محصولات مکمل، بازیابی سبدهای خرید رهاشده و بازاریابی مجدد برای مشتریان قبلی.
افزایش فروش برند مونته آدلمو (Monte Adelmo)
این برند یکی از اولویت‌های اصلی فروشگاه است. به دنبال راهکارهایی برای اعتمادسازی، معرفی محصولات، انتخاب کالاهای دارای پتانسیل فروش، بازاریابی محتوایی و تبدیل بازدیدکنندگان گوگل و ترب به خریداران این برند هستیم.
تحلیل آمار و سودآوری کانال‌های فروش
نیاز داریم با استفاده از اطلاعات Google Search Console، Matomo، WooCommerce و پنل ترب، عملکرد واقعی کانال‌ها را تحلیل کنیم و شاخص‌هایی مثل نرخ تبدیل، میانگین مبلغ سفارش، هزینه جذب مشتری، بازگشت هزینه تبلیغات و سودآوری را بررسی کنیم.
خروجی مورد انتظار
انتظار داریم مشاور پس از بررسی اطلاعات واقعی فروشگاه، یک برنامه اجرایی، دقیق و اولویت‌بندی‌شده برای ۳۰ تا ۹۰ روز آینده ارائه دهد؛ شامل اقدامات پیشنهادی، ابزارهای موردنیاز، اولویت محصولات، شاخص‌های سنجش موفقیت و روش ارزیابی نتایج.
هدف ما دریافت توصیه‌های عمومی یا صرفاً افزایش بازدید نیست. به دنبال راهکارهای اختصاصی، قابل‌اندازه‌گیری و متناسب با شرایط واقعی فروشگاه هستیم.
شرایط مشاور
فردی که تجربه عملی و قابل‌ارائه در افزایش فروش فروشگاه‌های اینترنتی، مدیریت تبلیغات ترب، ووکامرس، CRO، تحلیل داده و بازاریابی عملکردی (Performance Marketing) داشته باشد.
در پیشنهاد همکاری لطفاً تجربه پروژه‌های مشابه، روش بررسی و تحلیل فروشگاه، خروجی قابل‌تحویل مشاوره و هزینه پیشنهادی را اعلام کنید.

items.title: SEO & Content Specialist
items.location: Sarajevo, Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bosnia and Herzegovina (Remote)
items.description:
Aim the content engine and hold the quality line. Sarajevo, hybrid.
We don't sit and write blog posts by hand. We build content: our platform produces it at volume, and the job is to aim it well and hold the line on what comes out. Deciding what gets built, feeding the system the right inputs, and catching everything that isn't good enough to ship. We need go-getters who put in the work, learn fast, and take it personally when a client isn't seeing results.

What you will do
Keyword research, competitor analysis, and finding the topics worth building for.
Turning that research into the briefs, prompts and inputs our platform runs on.
Producing and publishing content through our internal platform, and reviewing what comes out: is it accurate, does it answer the query, does it sound like the client, would anyone read it.
On-page optimisation: titles, meta descriptions, internal linking, content structure.
Tracking rankings, traffic and content performance in Google Search Console and GA4, plus basic technical checks and how client brands show up in AI answers.

What you bring
Obsession with client outcomes. You check a client's rankings before you check your own notifications.
Strong English, written and spoken. Most clients are in the US and EU, and you judge whether content reads right for them.
Judgment. You can tell content that is technically fine from content that is actually good, and say what needs to change.
Curiosity, care with data and spreadsheets, and the habit of digging in before asking.
Heavy, opinionated use of AI. We use it a lot, and the whole job is knowing what to do with what it gives you.
Availability to work from our Sarajevo office on hybrid days. Nice to have: your own blog or site, WordPress or Shopify, Excel, basic HTML.

items.title: SEO & GEO Specialist
items.description:
About Pillar

Pillar is an Italian startup founded on February 13, 2025. In less than a year, we raised €15.2 million to revolutionize the construction industry, and we are growing fast. Our mission is to rebuild its foundations. Our ambition is to manage 1 in 3 construction sites in Europe. We are Italian, but with a European vision 🚀

The Italian construction industry is the backbone of the country's economy, involving nearly 5 million people, yet it is still managed with outdated tools.

Pillar was built to solve this problem at its root. We have built an all-in-one platform that allows construction companies to oversee every job site and monitor profitability in real time.

Why Join Us Now

Organic search is one of the growth channels with the greatest long-term potential: every page that ranks today can become a source of qualified leads tomorrow.

We already have the foundations: a structured blog, interactive tools that help construction professionals answer practical questions, and a website that attracts traffic every day. Now we need someone to turn these assets into a scalable organic growth engine.

You'll help Pillar rank on Google, become a trusted source for AI-powered search experiences, and attract construction companies ready to discover our platform.

This isn't a role where you simply publish a few articles every month. It's an opportunity to shape how an entire industry finds information, answers questions and discovers Pillar.

The Team

You'll report to the Growth & Performance Manager, working closely with the Performance Marketing team, our frontend developer and our data analyst.

You'll own the organic growth roadmap and collaborate with our Brand team on content and brand consistency.

At Pillar, paid and organic search work together. Your research will inform our Google Ads strategy, while paid campaign data will help you identify what converts before investing months in organic positioning.

Like the rest of our central Growth function, you'll support every market Pillar enters: Italy first, Spain next, and other European countries as we expand.

What You'll Do

In practice:

Own organic growth end to end: lead keyword and search-intent research, site architecture, content planning, editorial briefs, internal linking and content refreshes, connecting the first search to the booked demo.
Make Pillar a source AI trusts and cites: optimize content for AI-powered search experiences across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI search features. Use clear definitions, reliable data, FAQs, entity optimization and structured data to improve visibility and monitor AI citations.
Build scalable pages and tools: turn regional price lists, labour costs and regulatory deadlines into useful landing pages and interactive resources that answer real customer questions and attract organic traffic.
Keep our website technically sound: work with our frontend developer on crawling, indexing, JavaScript rendering, structured data and Core Web Vitals. Identify issues, translate them into actionable tickets and validate the fixes.
Turn traffic into qualified opportunities: optimize calls to action, gated tools and conversion paths, ensuring that organic visitors can become qualified leads and booked demos.
Build authority and credibility: develop digital PR initiatives with trade publications and industry associations, create studies based on anonymized company data, and earn high-quality backlinks.

Your one goal: make organic search one of Pillar's most cost-effective sources of qualified demos in every market we enter.

Your First 90 Days

Month 1: conduct a comprehensive technical, content and AI visibility audit. Map search intent across the Italian market and spend time with Sales and customers to understand their real questions and challenges.
Month 2: launch the first scalable page templates, implement technical improvements and establish an editorial calendar based on your content briefs.
Month 3: introduce a monthly organic performance report connected to pipeline, establish a benchmark for AI citations and define the organic growth strategy for Spain.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines strategic SEO expertise, technical understanding and a strong focus on business outcomes.

You think in terms of search intent, not just traffic volume. A keyword that generates 50 searches and drives qualified demos is more valuable than one that attracts thousands of irrelevant visitors.
You understand how AI-powered search selects and references sources, and you've tested strategies to improve visibility rather than relying on theory alone.
You're technically confident: you can read HTML, understand rendering and indexing, and work effectively with developers to implement SEO improvements.
You recognize what makes content useful. You can improve a weak brief, sharpen a vague headline and make sure the answer to a customer's question is clear and easy to find.
You automate repetitive work. You use AI and scripts for tasks such as keyword clustering, content briefs, internal linking and monitoring, without sacrificing quality or producing generic content.
You connect SEO to business performance. Rankings and traffic are important, but qualified leads and demos are what ultimately matter.

Requirements

3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with measurable organic growth demonstrated through Google Search Console or similar tools, ideally in B2B or considered-purchase environments.
Strong technical SEO knowledge, including crawling, indexing, JavaScript rendering, structured data and Core Web Vitals.
Experience developing content strategies, topic clusters, editorial briefs, editorial calendars and content refreshes.
Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4 and professional SEO tools such as Semrush or Ahrefs.
Native-level Italian and fluent English.

Nice to Have:

Experience with programmatic SEO and scalable landing-page templates.
Hands-on experience with GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) or AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), supported by measurable results.
International SEO experience, including hreflang and multi-market strategies; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.
Experience with digital PR or link building, particularly in traditional industries.
Familiarity with Next.js, React, headless CMS platforms, Python or Google Apps Script for automation.
Some experience with paid search and performance marketing.
Previous experience in a startup or high-growth environment.

You don't need to know what “congruità della manodopera” means yet. Give it a month, and you'll rank for it.

How We Work at Pillar

At Pillar, we row in the same direction: when one of us accelerates, we all move forward. We're ambitious, we raise the bar, and we take ownership of our work.

We offer clear goals, the tools to succeed, direct communication and honest feedback. We move fast, challenge assumptions and avoid unnecessary bureaucracy.

Pillar isn't for you if you want clearly defined boundaries, already-perfect processes, a calm pace, or someone telling you exactly what to do every day.

What we offer

Compensation: €30.000/€40.000 gross annual salary, depending on experience and impact.
Benefits: €1.000 in fringe benefits, €1.000 in welfare benefits + €8/day meal vouchers.
Ownership: real responsibility for a critical growth area, with a direct impact on acquisition and business results.
Growth: meritocratic progression, where impact drives advancement.
Location: Milan, on-site
Team: a young, ambitious, and collaborative team focused on building something meaningful.
Offsites: team gatherings every six months.

Our Hiring Process

An introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition team.
A practical case based on one of our real business topics: a search-intent map, a scalable page template and a plan to improve AI citations. Approximately two hours of independent work.
A technical interview with our Growth Marketing Manager, starting from your case.
A final conversation with our VP of Growth.

Ready to Apply?

Show us what you can do. Share one page you've grown, including its URL, the before-and-after performance in Search Console, the actions you took and what you would do differently today, now that AI increasingly answers questions directly.

If you want to publish articles someone else has already planned, this probably isn't the right role.

If you want the pages you build to be the first thing a construction professional reads when something changes, we'd love to hear from you.

Let's build something great. Together. 🧱🚀

Compensation Range: €30K - €40K

🔹 برای بهبود سئوی پروژه‌ای با مخاطب بین‌المللی، به دنبال همکاری دورکار با متخصص یا تیم سئو هستیم.

- بررسی کامل وضعیت فنی سایت و تهیه ممیزی فنی.
- رسیدگی به مشکلات ایندکس، Crawl و خطاهای Search Console.
- بهینه‌سازی Core Web Vitals و سرعت صفحات.
- بررسی و اصلاح sitemap، robots.txt و ساختار URL.
- پیاده‌سازی یا اصلاح داده‌های ساختاریافته (Schema).
- بررسی و اصلاح hreflang، x-default و canonical در همه زبان‌ها و اطمینان از ایندکس درست نسخه هر زبان در بازار مربوط به خودش.
- تحقیق کلمات کلیدی برای بازارهای هدف و هر زبان، تحلیل رقبا و فرصت‌های رتبه‌گیری، و تهیه نقشه کلمات کلیدی برای صفحات موجود و جدید.
- بهینه‌سازی عنوان، متا دیسکریپشن، هدینگ‌ها و محتوای صفحات اصلی و طراحی ساختار لینک‌سازی داخلی.
